key_features: Two algorithms, selectable per client key: token_bucket — bucket refills continuously at a configured rate; bursts allowed up to a cap. sliding_window — allows up to N requests in any trailing time window, based on real timestamps. Persistent state — bucket/window state lives in Postgres, not JVM memory. Restarting the service picks up exactly where it left off. Admin API to configure rate/burst/algorithm per client at runtime. Dashboard — check keys, configure clients, and watch live stats, all in the browser. Load-tested for correctness under concurrency: a single key hammered by 500 threads at once still never over-spends its bucket.

title: Weather-Application-using-react
description: Weather Application using React – Developed a responsive weather forecasting application using React.js that provides real-time weather information for any city. Integrated a weather API to display temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather conditions with a clean, user-friendly interface. Implemented dynamic search functionality, asynchronous API calls, and responsive design to ensure a seamless experience across desktop and mobile devices.

title: Travel booking website
description: Travel Booking Website is a responsive web application developed using React.js that provides an intuitive platform for users to explore and book travel destinations. The application features a modern user interface where users can browse popular destinations, view travel packages, and access detailed trip information. Built with a component-based architecture, it delivers a fast and seamless user experience across desktop and mobile devices. The project demonstrates front-end development skills, responsive design principles, and dynamic UI development using React.
key_features: Features 🌍 Browse popular travel destinations 🔍 Search and explore travel packages 📍 View detailed destination information 📱 Fully responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile 🎨 Modern and attractive user interface ⚡ Fast navigation with React 🖼️ Interactive image galleries 📅 Trip booking interface 💰 Display package pricing and travel details ❤️ Easy-to-use and intuitive user experience 🔄 Component-based architecture for maintainability 🚀 Optimized performance with React
